description: Deletes a specific service hook from a Sentry project using its organization, project, and hook identifiers.

inputSchema.description: Defines the request parameters for deleting a service hook from a Sentry project.

hook_id.description: The unique identifier (GUID) of the service hook to be deleted from the specified project.
hook_id.title: Hook Id

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry organization to which the project and service hook belong.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

project_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry project from which the service hook will be removed.
project_id_or_slug.title: Project Id Or Slug

inputSchema.title: DeleteProjectHookRequest

name: delete_project_hook

DeleteProjectHookResponse.description: Response for deleting a project service hook. The API returns 204 No Content with no response body on success.
DeleteProjectHookResponse.title: DeleteProjectHookResponse
